reason: Reproduced exactly by driving the master. Every number in the finding is correct to the pixel. At 1279x800 owner-flight: .b-two computes to a single 1068px track (grid-template-columns resolves to '1068px', .b-stick position:static), rail x=206, every .b-title right edge 774, .b-field right 1230 - a 456px dead band beside all seven rows; scrollHeight 2501 vs 2130 at 1280 (+371, 17% across one pixel of window); first .b-item top y=941, measured identically at 1024x768, 1100x800, 1152x800 and 1279x800, i.e. 141px below an 800px fold. The shipped shot approach-owner-flight--1279x800.png shows it plainly: the whole first screen is bar, count, date, today rule, gap note and an empty rail with not one moment, and the right 55% of the frame is black. The 1280x900 shot of the same state shows two moments and a finished composition. It is not already handled and not restated by the gates: interaction-check.mjs touches this band only to assert .b-todayRule is one width at 701/1152/1279/1280/1440 and to tab the docked editor at 1024 - nothing asserts the fold or the two-column layout above 390x844 - while elevate.config.json lists 1152 and 1279 as first-class viewports. The .b-copy comment in b.css ('the wash behind a moment ran 944px at 1279 and 544px at 1280') proves this exact boundary was inspected in an earlier round and only its symptom was patched. No constraint is touched: layout only, no colour, weight or architecture. The one thing the finding gets wrong is its own fix, which is why the sharpened version below replaces it.
sharpenedFix: Do NOT ship the finding's clamp values - driven at the gate's own widths they break a currently passing assertion. clamp(280px, 26vw, 344px) makes .b-todayRule 344/300/333/333/344 at 701/1152/1279/1280/1440, so interaction-check.mjs 'today is one mark at every width' (widths.size === 1) fails, and it also shrinks the shipping 1280 desk rule from 344 to 333 - a regression on a width that is currently right. Ship the geometry unchanged instead and move only the boundary: change @media (min-width: 1280px) to @media (min-width: 1024px) with grid-template-columns: 344px minmax(0, 1fr) and gap: 56px exactly as they are, keep [data-medium] .b-measure padding-left at 124px, and carry .b-stick and the .b-editHost .b-edit rail rules into the same block. Then move the paired sheet block from @media (max-width: 1279px) to @media (max-width: 1023px), or the undo bar stays fixed to the bottom edge while the editor sits in the rail - the finding's fix does not mention that block at all, and the two boundaries are one decision. Driven with exactly that: .b-todayRule stays 344 at all five gate widths, no horizontal overflow and no clipped .b-title in owner-flight, owner-editing, publish, desk, day or owner-empty at 1024 and 1152; the rail editor fits the 344 column (scrollWidth 342, position relative, nothing overflowing .b-stick); first moment top comes back to y=570 and scrollHeight to 2130 at every width from 1024 up; and a render at 1024x768 puts two moments above the fold with the horizon beside them. Total change is roughly four media-query bounds in b.css.
